title: Fraud Risk Management: 2018-2022 Data Show Federal Government Loses an Estimated $233 Billion to $521 Billion Annually to Fraud, Based on Various Risk Environments
notes: Establishes GAO's government-wide estimated annual fraud-loss range using fiscal years 2018-2022 data. GAO states that the model is uncertainty-bounded, is not predictive, should not be applied at the agency or program level, cannot isolate pandemic fraud, and is not comparable to improper-payment estimates. The receipt may be used as a government-wide scale control, not as proof of DOGE-specific detection failure, program-level fraud, or future-year fraud loss.
